Presentation follows the deploy-safe form; the hidden block informed only the rubric (demo/rubrics/osce-d2.json). Clinically shaped, not clinically reviewed. EP4's masquerader, rehearsed with the mask half off: cancer on hormone therapy, a swollen calf nobody asked about, a clear chest that should not be this hypoxic. The teaching is pretest thinking — Wells first, then the scan, then the anticoagulation the scan has earned. The d-dimer is a stall at high probability; lytics for a patient still holding her pressure are a bleed bought for nothing. Anticoagulation is gated on the CTPA the way B gated reperfusion on the ECG.

effects.beat: — "It hit while I was hanging the washing — a stab with every breath, and I cannot get a full one in." Sudden, pleuritic, out of nowhere.
— "Breast cancer, two years now. I take the hormone tablets every night." Malignancy and hormones — a clot's two best friends.
the right calf sits three centimetres fuller than the left, warm and tender — a source, wearing a sock
— "My right calf has been tight for a week. I thought it was the standing." Nobody had asked.
clear fields, both sides — a chest this clear has no business being this hypoxic
cancer, a hundred and fifteen a minute, a swollen calf, nothing else it could be — wells 7, high. the next test is the scan, not the dimer.
1200 — and it changes nothing: at high probability a dimer cannot rule out, it can only stall the scan
sinus tachycardia; an s1q3t3 if you squint — supportive, never diagnostic
a clean film — the great mimic leaves no shadow
a filling defect sits fat in the right pulmonary artery — the masquerader, unmasked in one pass of the gantry
the mask goes on — she holds it to her face herself
a careful 500 and no more — a strained right heart drowns in enthusiasm

then.beat: low-molecular-weight heparin into the belly — the clot stops growing tonight

else.beat: the scan first — name the clot, then starve it. heparin wants a target on film.

effects.beat: the lytic is drawn up and runs — the pump counts it down beside the bed
pulmonary embolism — the masquerader named while it still matters

effects.beat: reassurance taken gratefully — she reaches for her coat
up to the unit on the infusion — the calf gets its ultrasound tomorrow
